description: Defines the core profile and attributes of a Saga Proto player character.

description.description: A short description of the character's appearance or demeanor.

avatar.description: An optional image representing the character's avatar.

health.description: Current health points. When it reaches 0, the character is incapacitated.

sanity.description: Current sanity points. Loss can lead to madness effects.

intellect.description: Measures mental prowess, logic, and knowledge.

charisma.description: Measures social grace, persuasion, and presence.

locationRef.description: A strong reference to the character's current location (a com.cacheblasters.saga.proto.world.location record).

associatedBskyDid.description: The DID of the user's associated Bluesky social profile, for out-of-game integrations like DMs.

currencies.description: A map of currency identifiers to the amount the character possesses.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the character was created.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for additional, non-standard character data. Realms can use this to add their own stats/properties.
